item.title: Catherine O'Hara, star of 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek,' dies at 71
item.description: Renowned actress Catherine O'Hara has died at the age of 71, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Public's help wanted in finding 21-year-old missing woman from North County
item.description: The San Diego County Sheriff's Office is seeking public assistance in locating 21-year-old Jada Morrison, who was last seen in 4S Ranch on Dec. 21 and has since been spotted in Oceanside and Hayward, California.

item.title: Police investigate reports of man armed with shotgun near Navy gas station
item.description: San Diego Police and US Navy officials are investigating reports of a possibly armed man near a gas station in Barrio Logan, who fled the area and was last seen heading towards the 5 freeway.

item.title: Select San Diego streets to get metered parking in February
item.description: San Diego will be installing metered parking on select streets in February in several communities, including Normal Heights, Kensington, Talmadge, and City Heights, to promote turnover and improve the chances of people finding a parking spot.

item.title: North County high school teacher arraigned on child sexual abuse material charges
item.description: A North County high school teacher was arraigned in court on Wednesday for allegedly possessing and attempting to purchase child sexual abuse material online, and could face at least three years in state prison if convicted.

item.title: San Diego Padres hit home run with annual community tour
item.description: The San Diego Padres completed their annual Padres Community Tour, visiting local schools and organizations to thank fans and give back to the community.

item.title: VIDEO: Friendly sea lion hangs out on kayak in La Jolla
item.description: A sea lion hopped onto a woman's kayak in La Jolla Cove and made himself comfortable next to her, but she resisted his advances and followed the recommended guidelines of staying at least 50 feet away from wild sea lions.

item.title: CA Attorney General suing Rady Children’s Health after cutting gender-affirming care
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has filed a lawsuit against Rady Children's Health for dropping gender-affirming care for patients under 19, alleging the hospital violated its merger agreement and California law by complying with the Trump administration.

item.title: People rally in San Diego in solidarity with Minnesota
item.description: Various protests happened across San Diego County on Friday in solidarity with nationwide movements against federal immigration enforcement actions in Minnesota, including a large rally and march in San Diego's Teralta Park.

item.title: San Diegans take part in nationwide shutdown over immigration enforcement
item.description: Thousands of San Diegans participated in a national shutdown to protest the federal immigration crackdown, with many businesses and organizations taking a stand by donating funds to different organizations or providing a place of solace for those affected.
